title: Project Architecture (Verified)
content: The system uses a four-layer architecture: UI Shell → OS Services → Agent Runtimes → Execution Providers.

title: Runtime Adapter Contract
content: All runtimes must implement the RuntimeAdapter interface. No direct coupling between the UI shell and runtime internals.

title: Preferred Code Style
content: User prefers functional components with hooks, explicit return types, and comprehensive JSDoc comments.

title: Current Focus: Auth Module Review
content: Currently reviewing the auth module for security vulnerabilities. Hermes is running analysis, awaiting results.

title: Q3 Competitive Analysis Draft
content: Initial findings on 6 competitor agent frameworks. Key differentiator: unified runtime adapter model.
